outcome: Time to normal menstrual function recovery
Time to normal β-human chorionic gonadotropin (β-HCG) level
cohort: 152 women with cesarean scar pregnancy (85 treated with HIFU, 77 treated with UAE)
finding: Both HIFU and UAE combined with suction curettage under hysteroscopy are safe and effective for managing cesarean scar pregnancy, but HIFU resulted in less intraoperative blood loss and shorter duration of postoperative vaginal bleeding.
mod_finding: Both HIFU and UAE combined with suction curettage under hysteroscopy are safe and effective for managing cesarean scar pregnancy.
